BEAT/PHRASE/SECTION/TRACK now change the actual ring time domain and touch scrub range rather than acting mainly as labels
phone scope controls move to a horizontal thumb-reachable strip above transport

mobile scoped scrubbing freezes the active BEAT/PHRASE/SECTION/TRACK time window for the lifetime of each pointer gesture, preventing the domain from sliding under the finger
center witness appends HOLD while a scoped gesture owns the frozen time window; release resumes live scope tracking
USE TRACK workflow dock makes the existing cross-surface affordances explicit: LIVE ride / READFIELD RSVP / TWO DIAL compose / AUDIO MAP export

workflow launches publish a fresh FIELD PULSE transport snapshot before opening a sibling surface

generic field-addressed-stream/v0.1 module separates address/aperture/pin laws from audio semantics
horizontal trackpad or shift-wheel scrubs address within the current aperture while vertical wheel/up-down changes aperture
left/right arrows fine-scrub the active aperture; shift-left/right preserves explicit beat-step behavior
source-scoped PIN annotations persist locally, can be sought/edited/removed, render as ring witnesses and export beside rather than inside AUDIO MAP evidence
DEEP analysis adds provider-independent 12-bin chroma key + major/minor estimate with explicit confidence
best-effort provider BPM/key/time-signature metadata is preserved when actually present but never required
LISTEN UI now names SOURCE → ADDRESS → APERTURE → FIELD and treats audio as the first host of a transferable stream lens
FIELD PULSE contract intentionally remains unchanged; harmonic identity stays durable/local until a consumer proves need
panel scrolling is isolated from global address/aperture wheel gestures
constraints: no upload/network required for user audio
analysis is intentionally approximate and interpretable; not claimed equivalent to Audiosurf or commercial MIR
do not merge this into Two Dial/Ecology until direct play proves a useful relation
no external analysis dependency in 0.1; professional MIR/SoundFont donors are researched separately
remote source adapters are best-effort and network/CORS dependent; local file intake remains the authority path
Suno clip/CDN endpoint behavior is external and may change; adapter failure must not break LISTEN
plain lyrics discovered in metadata are source evidence only; no synchronization claim until timed alignment exists
FIELD PULSE is ephemeral coordination only; AUDIO MAP + source hash remain the durable evidence objects
scope semantics must remain useful without another app connected
workflow links coordinate existing instruments; they do not create a new workflow authority or transfer source/audio ownership
READFIELD tempo handoff may use the latest same-session LISTEN snapshot when live cross-tab pulse is unavailable; UI must distinguish LIVE from LAST
PIN annotations are authored evidence and must never be folded into machine-derived AUDIO MAP truth
generic addressed-stream donor contains no beat, song, waveform or READFIELD-specific semantics
key/mode estimate is approximate MIR evidence, not ground truth and not musical authority
provider metadata fields are opportunistic provenance only; undocumented Suno fields must not become required contracts
horizontal address and vertical aperture must remain perceptually distinct on trackpad/touch/keyboard
do not implement a second stream host until LISTEN 0.3 interaction survives direct use
